interpretation: author-written operational microtasks; no benchmark estimate, deployment or custody claim
system: Return only the requested JSON object. Do not explain. Use only the supplied record and policy.

rubric.format: single JSON object; no prose or code fences; reject duplicate members and nonfinite values
rubric.quality: object member order and JSON whitespace ignored; recursively exact keys, array order, types and values; bool is not integer

order: configuration-major then frozen case order; one attempt per pair; no retries, repair, examples, answer extraction or adaptive selection

resources.elapsed: monotonic nanoseconds around each backend call
resources.cpu: whole-process CPU delta including inference worker threads
resources.rss: Linux whole-process lifetime peak KiB; shared high-water mark, not per-call allocation
resources.tokens: native llama.cpp prompt/completion counts; preflight counts tokenize exact submitted prompt
resources.limits: hard process-group 595s TERM plus 5s KILL; preflight cumulative prompt and completion maxima; late native returns are retained and reported separately

decision: complete retained evidence permits publication of this scoped report, not admission or dispatch of real effects; task quality reported separately by family/configuration; absent attempts remain in denominator
